tagline.en: Tencent's HunyuanVideo 1.5 — the next-generation Hunyuan video model for text-to-video and image-to-video.
tagline.zh: 腾讯的 HunyuanVideo 1.5——新一代混元视频模型，支持文生视频与图生视频。

en: HunyuanVideo 1.5 is the next generation of Tencent's Hunyuan video model, covering text-to-video and image-to-video. It builds on the Hunyuan video line with an updated architecture.

In WorldFoundry, the text-to-video and image-to-video paths are exposed as independent recipes over one shared diffusion infrastructure. The model contributes its own network, codec, and conditioning; the image-to-video route additionally uses FLUX.1-Redux-dev as a separate vision checkpoint for image conditioning.

You supply the checkpoints locally. The main HunyuanVideo 1.5 license is listed as "other," and the image-to-video FLUX.1-Redux-dev asset is gated with non-commercial terms — review both before redistribution or automated download.
zh: HunyuanVideo 1.5 是腾讯混元视频模型的新一代，覆盖文生视频与图生视频。它在混元视频系列基础上采用了更新的架构。
在 WorldFoundry 中，文生视频与图生视频路径以独立配方的形式暴露，共用同一套扩散基础设施。模型贡献自有的网络、编解码器与条件模块；图生视频路径还额外使用 FLUX.1-Redux-dev 作为独立的视觉 checkpoint 来做图像条件。
你在本地自备 checkpoint。HunyuanVideo 1.5 主许可标注为 "other"，而图生视频所用的 FLUX.1-Redux-dev 资产为门控且带非商业条款——再分发或自动下载前请查阅两者。

whenToUse.en: Reach for HunyuanVideo 1.5 when you want Tencent's newer-generation video model with both text-to-video and image-to-video, and can supply the checkpoints yourself.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想使用腾讯新一代视频模型，同时具备文生视频与图生视频，且能自备 checkpoint 时，可选 HunyuanVideo 1.5。

notFor.en: Licensing needs care: the main model is "other," and image-to-video requires the gated, non-commercial FLUX.1-Redux-dev asset. Review terms before redistribution or automated download.
notFor.zh: 许可需谨慎：主模型为 "other"，图生视频还需要门控且非商业的 FLUX.1-Redux-dev 资产。再分发或自动下载前请查阅条款。

en: Next-generation Hunyuan video model from Tencent
Text-to-video and image-to-video as independent recipes
Image-to-video conditioning via a separate FLUX.1-Redux-dev vision checkpoint
Checkpoints are external; main license "other," FLUX asset gated
zh: 腾讯新一代混元视频模型
文生视频与图生视频作为独立配方
图生视频条件借助独立的 FLUX.1-Redux-dev 视觉 checkpoint
checkpoint 为外部资产；主许可 "other"，FLUX 资产门控
